name: Halfling
description:
Of modest height and build, Halflings are lighter on their feet than almost anyone has a right to be. Their senses are sharp, their reflexes quicker than their size implies, and they have a long-established reputation for appearing in exactly the place you weren't watching.

Height: 3-4' | Weight: 50-180 lbs | Average Lifespan: 125 years | Speed: 25
